result.title: Calibrated Reading of Latent Reasoning and Communication
result.summary: Latent reasoning and key-value communication store intermediate information in continuous representations, limiting direct inspection of model behavior. Existing activation readers trade the low cost of task-specific probes against the flexibility of language-model decoders. We propose the Calibrated Latent Reader, CLR, a compact transformer that predicts reasoning outcomes and message content through task-conditioned interactions between states and candidate answers. Source adapters support transfer across models, while conformal calibration provides coverage and false-alarm guarantees under exchangeability. On two CODI models, CLR improves accuracy over MLP and attention probes by 4-18 percentage points for final-answer prediction and reference-value membership. On CODI-GPT-2, it achieves accuracy comparable to a 1.7B LatentQA-based verbalizer using 437-648 times fewer inference FLOPs. On synthetic Qwen3-4B communications, comparing decoded facts with public commitments detects 93.1% of message substitutions at a nominal 5% false-positive rate.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Calibrated Latent Reader（CLR），用紧凑 transformer 通过状态与候选答案的任务条件交互来预测推理结果与消息内容，并以 source adapter 支持跨模型迁移、用 conformal calibration 给出覆盖率与误报保证；在 CODI 模型和合成 Qwen3-4B 通信上验证其优于 MLP/attention probe，且比大模型 verbalizer 省算力。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「从 latent 状态读出答案/消息内容并带误报控制」的探针思路，可供核查 latent 表示是否真正承载任务信息与通信保真度，含视觉或多模态场景的可迁移性尚待确认。
